subject.name: Chemistry for Engineers
subject.description: First-year general chemistry with an engineering slant: atomic structure, bonding, stoichiometry, gases, thermodynamics, equilibrium, kinetics, electrochemistry, and the chemistry of engineering materials.

depth_levels.awareness: Know it exists and recognize it
depth_levels.procedural: Apply it mechanically to standard problems
depth_levels.fluency: Combine it with other tools in multi-step problems
depth_levels.proof: State it precisely and derive or prove it
